title: WorkspaceGraph
description: Output of `dmtool workspace graph <dir>` — the model-INHERITANCE graph of a directory: nodes are the scanned models, edges are subtype→supertype relations derived from the super/subtype convention (the `superTypes`/`subTypes` header annotations, unioned across both declaration directions and deduped). Each edge is `resolved` iff BOTH ids name a scanned model (a false edge points at a model outside the scan — dangling, or out of scope; widen with --recursive). Inheritance only: the composition relations (includes / type-def imports) are surfaced per-model, resolved, by `workspace list` / `model info`.

nodes.description: the scanned models (the graph's vertices), ordered by relative path

path.description: the model file's path relative to the scanned root

abstract.description: the `abstract` convention — a base type, not instantiated directly

edges.description: subtype→supertype inheritance edges, ordered by (subtype, supertype)

resolved.description: true iff both ids are scanned models; false = an endpoint is outside the scan
